blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Manila recorded 35 new dengue cases on Monday, Nov. 9, bringing the city’s total to 4,769 from Jan. 1 to Nov. 9, according to the latest report from the Manila Health Department (MHD). Dengue had the highest cumulative case count among the illnesses monitored under the city’s W.I.L.D. diseases surveillance, based on figures extracted from the Electronic Disease Case Surveillance System (EDCS-IS) as of 7 a.m. on Monday.
